items.desc: description: Documentation for the Suvankar Free Dictionary API. [← All APIs](/) DICTIONARY API [Overview](overview)[Quick start](quickstart)[Try it out](tryitout)[Get definitions](definitions)[Search words](words)[Get translations](translations)[Word of the day](wordofday)[Rate limits](ratelimits) RESOURCES [Full endpoint notes ↗](https://github.com/suvankarmitra/freedictionaryrestapi/blob/main/endpoints.md) [Suvankar APIs](/)/Dictionary API API REFERENCE Free Dictionary API Look up English words and access definitions, word lists, translations, and a word of the day. Responses are JSON and no API key is required. i Base URLhttps://api.suvankar.cc Copy Overview All endpoints use HTTPS and return JSON. No API key is required. Use the quick start below to make your first request, or jump to an endpoint for its path, parameters, and examples. Requests are subject to rate limits to help protect service availability. Quick start Make your first request with curl. No SDK or API key is required. TerminalCopy curl 'https://api.suvankar.cc/dictionaryapi/v1/definitions/en/happy?compact=true' Example response (abbreviated): JSON { "word": "happy", "meanings": [...] } Try it out Look up an English word and inspect the live JSON response. English word Send request → Uses the public Dictionary API through this site's hostname. ResponseCopy JSON GET Get definitions Retrieve definitions and meaning data for an English word. /dictionaryapi/v1/definitions/en/{word}Copy example URL Query parameters compactboolean Optional · defaults to false. Requests a compact response. Example response JSON200 OK { "word": "happy", "meanings": [ { "partOfSpeech": "adjective", "senses": [ { "glosses": [ "feeling or showing pleasure and contentment" ] } ] } ] } GET Search words Retrieve a paginated list of words matching a prefix. /dictionaryapi/v1/words/en/?filter={filter}&page=0&size=10Copy example URL filterstring Required · prefix to search for. pageinteger Optional · page number, defaults to 0. sizeinteger Optional · number of results, defaults to 10. GET Get translations Retrieve translation data for a word, optionally filtered by part of speech. /dictionaryapi/v1/translations/en/?word={word}&pos={pos}Copy example URL wordstring Required · word to look up. posstring Optional · part of speech filter. GET Word of the day Retrieve the wordoftheday entry. /dictionaryapi/v1/wordofthedayCopy URL Rate limits The API enforces perclientIP rate limits. Limits are applied separately to the general dictionary endpoints and the Word of the Day endpoint. 30 requests/minuteGeneral dictionary endpoints Applies to definitions, word search, and translations: /dictionaryapi/v1/definitions, /dictionaryapi/v1/words, and /dictionaryapi/v1/translations. 5 requests/minuteWord of the Day Applies to the Word of the Day endpoint. Rate limits use a tokenbucket algorithm with greedy token refill. Tokens replenish continuously over the configured oneminute interval, rather than all at once at the end of each minute. Design clients to stay within these limits. Avoid tight retry loops; if a request is ratelimited, wait before retrying. Errors Requests may return standard HTTP error responses, including 400 for invalid requests, 404 when a resource is not found, and 500 for an unexpected server error. Endpoint details are based on the API repository's published endpoint notes. Confirm response schemas against the live service before treating examples as exhaustive. items.descZh: Suvankar Free Dictionary API 是一个无需 API 密钥的 RESTful 服务，旨在提供英语单词的查询功能，包括定义、翻译和单词列表。其核心功能涵盖获取单词定义、搜索匹配前缀的单词、获取翻译数据以及每日单词推荐，所有端点均通过 HTTPS 返回 JSON 格式响应。该 API 的亮点包括简单的集成流程、无需认证，以及具体的速率限制，如一般字典端点每分钟支持 30 次请求，每日单词端点每分钟支持 5 次请求，采用令牌桶算法动态补充令牌以管理流量。适用于需要快速集成字典功能的应用场景，如语言学习工具、文本编辑器或教育平台，帮助用户高效访问单词信息。

View all files Repository files navigation English · [繁體中文](/DennySORA/vpnmanager/blob/main/README.zhTW.md) · [日本語](/DennySORA/vpnmanager/blob/main/README.ja.md) VPN Manager Run several WireGuard exits side by side on your own computer, and decide which programs use which one. Each exit is reachable as a local SOCKS5/HTTP proxy, and a program you choose can be started so that the tunnel is its only way out. VPN Manager runs as your own user: no root, no kernel module, and your computer's routes, firewall and DNS stay exactly as they are. Everything else on the machine keeps using the normal network. The one promise: protected traffic either leaves through the tunnel of its connection, or it fails. It never falls back to the normal network. [](/DennySORA/vpnmanager/blob/main/docs/images/overview.en.webp) The screens in this README show a demo environment with madeup data. What it does Several exits at the same time A _connection_ is one WireGuard tunnel to one server. Run as many as you like, each with its own exit, DNS and rules. WireGuard and the TCP/IP stack run inside VPN Manager's own processes ([GotaTun](https://github.com/mullvad/gotatun) and [smoltcp](https://github.com/smoltcprs/smoltcp)). Nothing is installed into the system network, so there is nothing to clean up and nothing that changes how other programs connect. Three ways to send traffic through a connection Gateways — local proxy ports on 127.0.0.1 (SOCKS5, HTTP, or both on one port; UDP through SOCKS5). Point a browser or a commandline tool at one. Managed apps — VPN Manager starts a program for you and ties it to one connection. Three levels: _Environment variables_: the program is told to use the Gateway. _Enforced proxy_ (macOS): the program can reach nothing but the Gateway. _Strict isolation_ (Linux): the program runs in a network namespace of its own, where the tunnel is the only network interface. SSH — let chosen SSH hosts connect through a connection, and pull new files from a remote folder over SFTP on a schedule

items.title: Show HN: Browserr – An MCP-first browser for AI agents (one Rust binary)
items.desc: description: A Servobased browser engine for AI agents. Failclosed by default, MCPnative, with an optional native window for human handoff. One binary, no CDP, no Chromium. title: Browserr — browser engine for AI agents image: icon.svg [Skip to content](features) [browserr / engine]() [Features](features) [Protocol](protocol) [SDK](sdk) [Install](install) [GitHub](https://github.com/Omodaka9375/browserr) v0.6.2 · ★ open source Scope 01 / 05 Everything an agent needs. Built agentfirst: extraction over pixels, stable refs over coordinates, failures you can catch instead of hangs. Three commitments shape the whole engine: it blocks when unsure, it hands the page to a human when a human is needed, and it leaves evidence for everything it did. Command Covers read Structured page reads. Prose via read\_page(), or read\_structure(): every element with its rect and selector; fields carry label, constraints, state and validity. act Selector interaction. click\_element() and set\_value() — real pointer events, React/Vuesafe writes. wait SPAaware timing. Wait for selectors and readiness — no sleeps, no flaky scripts. observe Console capture. Page messages and network errors arrive as events. files Downloads. Fetched straight to disk, without page cookies. survive Fast failure, not hangs. A dead engine surfaces instantly; ephemeral profiles give every run a clean slate. block Adblock built in. EasyListbased, refreshed weekly. gpu Rendering. CPU by default — starts anywhere; gpu opts into hardware. Screenshots on demand, per tab. compat SPAready. React 18 and Vue 3 render and react; IntersectionObserver, IndexedDB, Web Animations, WebGL and WebGL2 (via ANGLE, no GPU needed), clipboard, DecompressionStream; requestIdleCallback and crypto.subtle digests via builtin shims where Servo omits them. secure Tokengated attach. Unauthenticated sockets get nothing — not even events. intercept Failclosed interception. Requests held for an allow / deny / respond decision; unanswered means denied after 5 s. auth Challenges surfaced, not swallowed. Auth and filepicker events; missing credentials fail closed. evidence Net evidence. Every fetch/XHR recorded in a ring buffer, in every frame. frames Frame tree. List frames and walk sameorigin ones; crossorigin frames report their url only. fill Form filling. A whole form in one round trip, with typeaware writes. submit Submit and read the outcome. Runs the page's validation, then reports url, alerts and invalid fields. point Shared references. Stable refs and numbered screenshot boxes: the agent says "click 7" and the human knows which one that is. proxy Upstream proxy routing. browser\_start(proxy=...) routes all http/https traffic through a CONNECT tunnel (basic auth in the URL, perengine rotation); document\_status reports the main document's real HTTP status so a block serving a fake 404 is distinguishable from a dead page. handoff Humans take over in a real native window. Start MCP with headed:true; direct mouse and keyboard input keep working while agent mutations are paused. CAPTCHA support still depends on Servo compatibility. trust Failclosed by design. Persistent profiles, evidence shots, an appendonly action log, a credential store and a confirm gate on payment submits. Protocol 02 / 05 The entire protocol, in full. JSON over loopback. One client, no hidden state — the opposite of CDP's 1000+ endpoints. Events: Commands 22 MCP tools 42 Binary \~120 MB CDP endpoints 0 Dependencies 0 SDK 03 / 05 Three ways in. Same engine underneath; pick the integration you already have. Surface Covers mcp Model Context Protocol server with 42 tools, stdlib only. Any MCPcapable agent — Claude, Kai, your own — drives Browserr with zero integration code. python driver.py wraps the raw protocol: navigation, extraction, form filling, screenshots. No dependencies. raw Anything that can write JSON lines to a socket. Bindings in any language are an afternoon. Position 04 / 05 Where it sits in 2026. Chromium wrappers are the default; alternative engines are the bet. Browserr's edge is the local, trustfirst, humanintheloop. items.title: Show HN: Open-Source Version of Cyclon: Phone where AI is the interface?
items.desc: description: OpenCyclone is a free, opensource AI agent for the Android phone you already own. It works in your apps and asks before it sends, pays, or deletes. title: OpenCyclone: don't buy an AI phone, just use the one you have image: https://opencyclone.vercel.app/brand/poster.png A real, working, opensource AI phone Don't buy an AI phone. Just use the one you have. OpenCyclone is a free, opensource version that converts your Android phone into an AI phone. [Install it now _→_](install.html) Not backed by anyone. Seriously. It was easy to build this. 2:44 PMFri, Oct 30 Good afternoon. A message to Maya is ready. ~~WhatsApp · Weekend plans~~Maya: Are you coming to dinner tonight? ~~Mail · Returns~~2 days left to return your vacuum cleaner. Tell the group I'm in for dinner at 7:30. Send this to Weekend plans? I'm in for 7:30. Send to Weekend plansNot now Opened · WhatsApp, in the background Hold power to talktype Scroll \[ ↓ \] \[01\]One device Why buy new hardware when you can just change the software? We live in an era of transient software This literally took a couple hrs to build. \[02\]Launch film Meet OpenCyclone. \[03\]Ask Ask once. Your phone asks once back. It works in your apps on a hidden screen while you keep using your phone. Before anything is sent, paid, or deleted, it stops and shows you exactly what will happen. Messages Tell the group chat I'm running ten minutes late. Ready. Send this to the group? SendNot now Errands Set an alarm for 7 tomorrow. Done. Alarm set for 7:00 AM. No approval needed. Nobody was harmed. Calls If the courier calls, tell him to come up. I can't answer calls. Stock Android does not allow an app to do that. This is the one thing that needs a new phone. \[04\]Yours An OS that adapts to you. It is called Android. You have it. 01 Build your own apps Ask for the tool you need. The phone writes a small app, tests it, fixes it, and puts it on your home page. Change it by asking again. 02 Connect your services Bring your own model: sign in with ChatGPT, use OpenRouter, paste a key, or point it at a model on your own network. Add tools through the Model Context Protocol. 03 Delegate across your apps Keep the apps you already use. The agent works inside them with your accounts, follows the rules you set, and never opens the apps on your protected list. 04 Read every line The approval gate is code, not a promise in a prompt. You can read it, test it, and change it. That is what the word "open" is for. \[05\]Benchmarks We will also prove our CUA on benchmarks soon. (Sorry, I did not get time to get here yet, but I will do it. I promise.) 01 AndroidWorld Will do soon 02 MobileWorld Will do soon 03 Our own safety check Will do soon \[06\]Questions Questions and answers. What is OpenCyclone? An opensource AI agent for stock Android. It reads the screen of your apps on a hidden display, decides what to tap, and asks you before any action that cannot be taken back. Do I keep my apps? Yes. You also keep your phone, your operating system, and your money. What does it cost? $0\. There is no deposit, no preorder, and no delivery date. You install it today on the phone you have. You pay only your model provider, and a local model costs nothing. Why did you build it? Because it is easy to build. An AI phone is an app, a helper process, and a model. One person built this one with AI coding agents, on top of an existing opensource project. Nobody should buy a new phone to get it. What do I need? An Android phone with Android 12 or later, a computer for a onetime setup script, and an account with a model provider. It was built and tested on a Pixel 7. Is it finished? No. It is early software, written fast. Short tasks in one app work well. Long tasks across several apps fail more often. It tells you when it fails. Who is building it? One person and a small crowd of AI coding agents. It is backed by nobody. The code is under the Apache2.0 licence, so you can take it and build your own. Is this the same as Cyclon? No. Cyclon is a company that is building a real phone with its own operating system, and we wish them well. OpenCyclone is an independent opensource project that does the same kind of work on the phone you already have. It is not affiliated with Cyclon or with Y Combinator. Don't waste money on that. Just use your existing Android phone. If you can do it on your phone, you should be able to ask your phone to do it. That needs an app, not new hardware. [Install it now _→_](install.html)

items.descZh: OpenCyclone是一个免费的开源AI代理，旨在通过软件将现有Android手机转变为AI手机，避免用户购买新硬件。其核心功能是在后台隐藏屏幕运行，允许用户在应用中无缝交互，并在执行发送、支付或删除等不可逆操作前主动询问用户。亮点包括支持多种AI模型（如ChatGPT和OpenRouter）、通过模型上下文协议添加工具，以及代理在应用内工作而不干扰用户流程。具体性能方面，单应用任务如发送消息和设置闹钟运行良好，但跨应用任务失败率较高，软件仍处于早期阶段。适用场景涵盖日常任务如消息处理、邮件管理和提醒设置，特别适合不想升级硬件但希望体验AI功能的用户。
items.quote: 别买 AI 手机，用你现有的那部就行。

items.desc: For anyone who wants to control their MacBook charger light. For me, my MacBook lives in my bedroom most nights on charge and the light is quite bright. Config allows on/off automation with time, focus status, or persistently on/off. Open to features / suggestions via Github
items.author: toppa33
items.descZh: 这款工具旨在帮助用户控制 MacBook 充电器指示灯的亮灭，解决夜间卧室充电时灯光刺眼的问题。核心功能是提供基于时间、专注状态或手动设置的自动化开关选项，让充电灯在不需要时熄灭。项目采用开源模式，在 GitHub 上欢迎功能建议和贡献，体现了社区协作的灵活性。适用于需要在睡眠环境中保持黑暗，或希望根据个人作息和专注状态智能管理充电灯的用户。
items.quote: 配置支持基于时间、专注状态或持久开关来启用或关闭自动化。
items.titleZh: Show HN：MacBook 充电器指示灯控制（开源）
